facts.fact: General Notice 953 in Gazette 8808 records CRAN making regulations on accreditation of security products and services and certification service providers under sections 41 to 47 of the Electronic Transactions Act, 2019, published 17 December 2025, to commence on a date the Chairperson sets by gazette notice.
facts.system: Regulations regarding Accreditation of Security Products and Services and Providers of such Products and Services
